en.title: Training Communication-Efficient MoE Language Models with Layer Re-Configuration
en.hook: Overcome the all-to-all communication bottleneck in large-scale Mixture-of-Experts training with clever layer re-configuration.
key_takeaways: Addresses heavy communication overhead in expert parallelism (all-to-all token dispatch)
Introduces layer re-configuration to drastically reduce end-to-end training time
Maximizes scalability for distributed large language model training

zh.title: 通过层重配置训练通信高效的混合专家(MoE)语言模型
zh.hook: 通过巧妙的层重配置技术，大幅减少MoE模型分布式训练中的all-to-all通信瓶颈。
key_takeaways: 解决专家并行中all-to-all词元分发带来的繁重通信开销
通过层重配置显著缩短端到端训练时间
极大提升大规模语言模型分布式训练的可扩展性
